cases.title: Port relocation with overlap and zero service gap
cases.scenario: Old coastal terminal capacity 100 units/period; demand 80; new inland terminal is commissioned in stages.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Premature retirement before replacement corridor commission
cases.scenario: The existing corridor is retired one period before the replacement route can carry service.
cases.oracle: Per period delivered=min(demand, old_capacity+new_capacity); one interval has no available route.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Drought waterway substitution while preserving environmental flow
cases.scenario: Drought reduces navigation capacity. Rail and road substitute only within declared capacities; environmental flow is a hard gate.
cases.oracle: Delivered=min(demand, sum of mode capacities)=80. Do not create capacity by drawing down protected ecological flow.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Sediment-driven waterway retirement with habitat restoration
cases.scenario: Navigation channel loses viable depth under an admitted sediment/estuary scenario; cargo transfers to a qualified alternative while channel restoration maintains estuary connectivity.

expected.claim_ceiling: No local ecological or navigation feasibility claim.

cases.oracle: Navigation retirement and ecological restoration are separate state transitions with independent evidence gates.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Polycentric settlement split with group-level essential-service floors
cases.scenario: Population and productive functions redistribute across two settlement nodes; aggregate capacity must not conceal any group's service-floor breach.
cases.oracle: Evaluate every service x beneficiary group, not only regional aggregates.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Nominally separate corridors share a power and control failure domain
cases.scenario: Two terminal/corridor paths are topologically separate but both require one shared substation and control plane.
cases.oracle: An outage in the shared dependency domain disables both nominal paths; path count alone is not independence.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Repair-versus-replace whole-life carbon known answer
cases.scenario: Equivalent service alternatives over a fixed ten-year study horizon. All carbon factors are synthetic fixture inputs, not external emission factors.
cases.oracle: Total=embodied+horizon*annual_operational+end_of_life. No discounting or external factors in this fixture.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Trigger arrives too late for action lead time
cases.scenario: The trigger becomes observable only after monitoring delay; adaptation completes after the service threshold.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Minimax-regret pathway without invented scenario probabilities
cases.scenario: Three strategies are evaluated over three admissible futures with no calibrated probability model.
cases.oracle: Regret=best utility in each scenario minus strategy utility; minimize maximum regret. No probabilities are used.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Asset decommissioning, material recovery and corridor re-use
cases.scenario: A retired corridor is dismantled, reusable material recovered, contaminated fractions separately handled, and the alignment may become an ecological corridor.
cases.oracle: Decommissioning is an explicit lifecycle action and cannot be treated as zero-cost or zero-impact.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic transition semantics only; no real-site, hydraulic, ecological, legal, social, financial or engineering feasibility claim.
